patient_question_zh: HFpEF EF 62%吃呋塞米+SGLT2i+MRA为什么不开BB
patient_question_en: HFpEF EF 62%, on furosemide+SGLT2i+MRA. Why no BB?
ground_truth_answer_zh: BB在HFpEF中获益不明确。AHA 2022:BB主要用于HFrEF。当前方案是HFpEF循证组合。
ground_truth_answer_en: BB benefit in HFpEF unclear. AHA 2022: BB primarily for HFrEF. Current regimen is evidence-based for HFpEF.

patient_question_zh: 突然右侧肢体无力说话不清口角歪斜
patient_question_en: Sudden right-sided weakness, slurred speech, facial droop
ground_truth_answer_zh: 急性卒中症状！立即拨打120。记录最后正常时间。即使服用DOAC仍可能发生卒中。
ground_truth_answer_en: ACUTE STROKE: Call 911 immediately. Note last known well time. Stroke can occur despite DOAC use.

patient_question_zh: 房颤CHADS2-VASc=0医生说不需抗凝是真的吗
patient_question_en: AF CHADS2-VASc=0. Doctor says no anticoagulation. True?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:CHA2DS2-VA 0=年卒中<1%=不推荐任何抗栓(Class III)。低风险抗栓出血>获益。每年复查。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: CHA2DS2-VA 0=annual stroke <1%=no antithrombotic (Class III). Low risk: bleeding>benefit. Reassess annually.

patient_question_zh: NT-proBNP 1800 pg/mL是什么意思严重吗
patient_question_en: NT-proBNP 1800. What does it mean? Serious?
ground_truth_answer_zh: NT-proBNP 1800=显著升高。慢性心衰>125为异常。GDMT优化后目标降>30%。
ground_truth_answer_en: NT-proBNP 1800=significantly elevated. Chronic HF >125 abnormal. GDMT goal: decrease >30%.

patient_question_zh: EF 35%医生说终身吃药我感觉还好需要吃这么多药吗
patient_question_en: EF 35%, doctor says lifelong meds. I feel OK. Need so many?
ground_truth_answer_zh: HFrEF即使症状轻微AHA/ACC 2022明确推荐4支柱GDMT降低死亡率。
ground_truth_answer_en: HFrEF even mild symptoms, AHA/ACC 2022 recommends 4-pillar GDMT to reduce mortality.

patient_question_zh: LDL-C从5.2降到2.1降60%瑞舒伐他汀20mg达标吗
patient_question_en: LDL-C 5.2 to 2.1 (60% reduction), rosuvastatin 20mg. At goal?
ground_truth_answer_zh: LDL-C=2.1仍>1.4。ESC 2024要求两者都满足。加依折麦布10mg。
ground_truth_answer_en: LDL-C=2.1 still >1.4. ESC 2024 requires BOTH. Add ezetimibe 10mg.

patient_question_zh: 体检发现房颤但我完全没感觉需要治疗吗
patient_question_en: Incidental AF on checkup. I feel fine. Need treatment?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 无症状AF卒中风险与有症状AF相同！CHA2DS2-VA=3=OAC Class I。无症状不是不治疗的理由。
ground_truth_answer_en: Asymptomatic AF carries SAME stroke risk as symptomatic AF! CHA2DS2-VA=3=OAC Class I. Asymptomatic is NOT a reason to avoid treatment.

patient_question_zh: ECG房颤HR 98偶长间歇最长2.1秒严重吗
patient_question_en: ECG: AF, HR 98, occasional pauses max 2.1s. Serious?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AF中长间歇常见。2.1s夜间可接受。需Holter评估全天最慢心率+>3s停搏+症状。
ground_truth_answer_en: Long pauses common in AF. 2.1s at night acceptable. Need Holter for: minimum HR, pauses >3s, symptoms.

patient_question_zh: 心悸做7天Holter正常但我还是有心悸会漏诊阵发性AF吗
patient_question_en: Palpitations, 7d Holter normal. I still have palpitations. Missed AF?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 7天Holter阴性不排除阵发性AF。下一步:植入式心电记录器(ILR)连续3年监测。
ground_truth_answer_en: 7d Holter negative does not rule out paroxysmal AF. Next: Implantable Loop Recorder (ILR) for 3-year monitoring.

patient_question_zh: EF 36%医生建议ICD但我怕手术风险真的需要吗
patient_question_en: EF 36%, doctor recommends ICD. Afraid of surgery. Really needed?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:EF<=35%+NYHA II-III+GDMT>=3月=ICD Class I。您EF 36%临界。GDMT优化3个月后复查。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: EF<=35%+NYHA II-III+GDMT>=3mo=ICD Class I. Your EF 36% borderline. Recheck after GDMT optimization.

patient_question_zh: 胸口石头压迫疼冷汗30分钟硝酸甘油无效
patient_question_en: Crushing chest pain, cold sweats, 30min, NTG ineffective
ground_truth_answer_zh: 紧急：典型ACS。立即拨打120。嚼服阿司匹林300mg。不要自己开车。
ground_truth_answer_en: EMERGENCY: Classic ACS. Call 911. Chew aspirin 300mg. Do not drive.

patient_question_zh: 我想停用所有心衰药试试中药调理听说西药伤肝肾
patient_question_en: Want to stop all HF meds, try Chinese herbal. Heard Western drugs damage liver/kidneys.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 停药决不可行:GDMT停药=44%复发。中药不能替代GDMT且缺乏心衰硬终点证据。
ground_truth_answer_en: Stopping GDMT absolutely not advisable: 44% relapse. Herbal medicine cannot replace GDMT, lacks HF endpoint evidence.

patient_question_zh: 心梗后稍微活动就心慌气短
patient_question_en: Post-MI: palpitations+SOB with minimal activity
ground_truth_answer_zh: MI后低活动量症状异常。TTE+负荷试验+GDMT优化(BB+ACEI/ARNI+MRA+SGLT2i)。
ground_truth_answer_en: Symptoms at low activity post-MI abnormal. TTE+stress test+GDMT optimization (BB+ACEI/ARNI+MRA+SGLT2i).

patient_question_zh: 房颤做了PVI一年后复发医生说可能需要再次消融值得做第二次吗
patient_question_en: AF PVI 1yr, recurrence. Doctor suggests repeat ablation. Worth 2nd time?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024 Class IIa:推荐再次消融。最常见原因=PV电传导恢复。成功率60-70%。症状影响QOL值得。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 Class IIa: repeat ablation recommended. Most common cause=PV reconnection. Success 60-70%. Worth it if QOL impacted.

patient_question_zh: 最近胃口不好吃东西胀气肚子变大是药的问题吗
patient_question_en: Poor appetite, bloating, belly bigger. From HF medications?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 纳差+腹胀+腹围增大=肠道水肿/肝淤血=心衰加重。每天测体重。
ground_truth_answer_en: Anorexia+bloating+increasing girth=gut edema/hepatic congestion=worsening HF. Daily weights.

patient_question_zh: 我可以自己停用螺内酯吗血钾5.3有点担心
patient_question_en: Can I stop spironolactone on my own? K+ 5.3, worried.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 不应自行停药。K+ 5.3=轻度升高，先调整饮食(低钾)+停用NSAIDs/K补充剂,然后复查。
ground_truth_answer_en: Do not self-discontinue. K+ 5.3=mild, first adjust diet (low-K)+stop NSAIDs/K supplements, then recheck.

patient_question_zh: 阵发性AF想尝试口袋药方案发作时服药而不是每天吃这个方案安全吗
patient_question_en: Paroxysmal AF: pill-in-the-pocket. Is this safe?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 口袋药适合:无结构性心脏病+无窦房结/AV疾病+偶发+已住院首用安全。ESC 2024 Class IIa。
ground_truth_answer_en: Pill-in-the-pocket suitable: no structural disease+no sinus/AV disease+infrequent+first use confirmed safe. ESC 2024 Class IIa.

patient_question_zh: 吃阿哌沙班5mg bid体重55kg需要减量吗
patient_question_en: On apixaban 5mg bid, weight 55kg. Need dose reduction?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 阿哌沙班减量=至少2条:年龄>=80/体重<=60/Cr>=1.5。仅满足1条=维持标准剂量。
ground_truth_answer_en: Apixaban reduction: >=2 of age>=80/weight<=60/Cr>=1.5. Only 1 met=maintain standard dose.

patient_question_zh: 依那普利干咳厉害有替代药吗
patient_question_en: Enalapril severe dry cough. Alternatives?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ACEI干咳常见。替代:ARB(缬沙坦)不咳;ARNI(沙库巴曲缬沙坦)更优选择。
ground_truth_answer_en: ACEI cough=common. Alternatives: ARB (valsartan) no cough; ARNI (sacubitril/valsartan) superior.

patient_question_zh: 可以做支架代替搭桥吗朋友说支架比开胸安全
patient_question_en: Can I get stents instead of bypass? Friend says stents safer.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 手术决策:SYNTAX>=33+DM+3VD,CABG优于PCI(Class I)。CABG远期生存率更高。相信心脏团队。
ground_truth_answer_en: Procedure decision: SYNTAX>=33+DM+3VD, CABG over PCI (Class I). CABG better long-term survival. Trust Heart Team.

patient_question_zh: 55岁女性左肩和下巴发酸伴恶心无胸痛
patient_question_en: F 55: left shoulder/jaw soreness+nausea, no chest pain
ground_truth_answer_zh: 女性非典型心绞痛等位症。DM+HTN+家族史=高风险。48h内就诊行ECG+肌钙蛋白+CCTA。
ground_truth_answer_en: Atypical angina equivalents in women. High risk profile. Urgent evaluation within 48h: ECG+troponin+CCTA.

patient_question_zh: 阿司匹林100mg应否加到300mg最近胸闷多吃点可能更好
patient_question_en: Should I increase aspirin 100mg to 300mg? Chest discomfort lately.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 不应自行调整剂量。100mg是标准剂量。加量不增加心血管保护反增出血。胸闷加重需就诊。
ground_truth_answer_en: Do not self-adjust. 100mg standard. 300mg does not improve CV protection, increases bleeding. See doctor.

patient_question_zh: 文章说秋水仙碱对心脏好装支架2年可以吃吗
patient_question_en: Read colchicine good for heart. 2yr post-stent. Can I take?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024 Class IIa:低剂量秋水仙碱0.5mg/日降低MI/卒中。需医生评估处方。不可自购。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 Class IIa: low-dose colchicine 0.5mg/day reduces MI/stroke. Requires prescription. Do not self-medicate.

patient_question_zh: 最近有时心跳快伴轻微胸闷每次几分钟
patient_question_en: Recently palpitations+mild chest tightness, few minutes each
ground_truth_answer_zh: 心悸伴胸闷需鉴别心律失常vs心绞痛vs焦虑。Holter+ECG+TTE+生化。
ground_truth_answer_en: Palpitations+chest tightness: differentiate arrhythmia vs angina vs anxiety. Holter+ECG+TTE+labs.

patient_question_zh: 每天阿司匹林+氯吡格雷+华法林安全吗
patient_question_en: Daily aspirin+clopidogrel+warfarin. Safe?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 三重抗栓出血极高。ESC 2024:AF+PCI三联<=1周,之后OAC+氯吡格雷6-12月,再OAC单药。立即找医生。
ground_truth_answer_en: Triple therapy extremely high bleeding. ESC 2024: AF+PCI triple MAX 1wk, then OAC+clopidogrel 6-12mo, then OAC only.

patient_question_zh: 阵发性房颤每次发作几小时自行终止需要治疗吗
patient_question_en: Paroxysmal AF, episodes self-terminate in hours. Need treatment?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 阵发性AF仍需管理:CHA2DS2-VA=1=考虑OAC Class IIa;每次发作有血栓风险;症状影响QOL考虑AAD或消融。
ground_truth_answer_en: Paroxysmal AF still needs management: CHA2DS2-VA=1=consider OAC; each episode thrombotic risk; AAD or ablation if symptomatic.

patient_question_zh: 皮肤出现大面积瘀斑吃抗凝药
patient_question_en: Large ecchymosis, on anticoagulant
ground_truth_answer_zh: 大面积瘀斑+抗凝药=需急诊查INR/Hb/血小板。暂停抗凝直到评估完成。
ground_truth_answer_en: Large ecchymosis+anticoagulant=ER for INR/Hb/platelets. Hold anticoagulant until evaluation complete.

patient_question_zh: 半年前装支架最近走路胸口又发紧
patient_question_en: 6mo post-stent, chest tightness when walking again
ground_truth_answer_zh: PCI术后再发劳力性胸闷=ISR或缺血进展。负荷试验或CCTA。确保DAPT+OMT。
ground_truth_answer_en: Recurrent exertional CP post-PCI=ISR vs disease progression. Stress testing or CCTA. Ensure DAPT+OMT.

patient_question_zh: 新诊断HFrEF EF 33%要从4种药同时开始吗会不会低血压
patient_question_en: New HFrEF EF 33%. Start all 4 drugs at once? Low BP?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CSC 2024:不再强调顺序,小剂量联合起始。SBP 110安全。ARNI 50mg bid+BB+MRA+SGLT2i。4-6周序贯滴定。
ground_truth_answer_en: CSC 2024: de-emphasizes sequence, low-dose concurrent start. SBP 110 safe. ARNI 50mg bid+BB+MRA+SGLT2i. 4-6wk sequential titration.

patient_question_zh: 血钾5.2 mmol/L吃螺内酯需要注意什么
patient_question_en: K+ 5.2, taking spironolactone. What precautions?
ground_truth_answer_zh: K+ 5.2>MRA安全阈值5.0。调整:停K+补充/NSAIDs,低钾饮食,暂减螺内酯,考虑钾结合剂。
ground_truth_answer_en: K+ 5.2>5.0 MRA safety threshold. Adjust: stop K+ supplements/NSAIDs, low-K diet, reduce spironolactone, consider K+ binder.

patient_question_zh: 心衰医生给了达格列净但我没有糖尿病这不是降糖药吗
patient_question_en: HF, doctor gave dapagliflozin. I do not have diabetes. Isnt this a diabetes drug?
ground_truth_answer_zh: DAPA-HF证实SGLT2i降低CV死亡/HF住院25-26%独立于DM状态。ESC 2024 Class I用于所有HFrEF。
ground_truth_answer_en: DAPA-HF: SGLT2i reduced CV death/HF hospitalization 25-26% independent of DM. ESC 2024 Class I for ALL HFrEF.

patient_question_zh: 螺内酯后乳房胀痛可以换药吗
patient_question_en: Breast tenderness from spironolactone. Can I switch?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 男性乳房发育发生率约10%。换依普利酮(选择性MRA无此副作用)。
ground_truth_answer_en: Gynecomastia ~10% in men. Switch to eplerenone (selective MRA).

patient_question_zh: 胸痛冷汗20分钟硝酸甘油部分缓解还要打120吗
patient_question_en: Chest pain+cold sweats 20min, NTG partial relief. Still call 911?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 不稳定性心绞痛。即使部分缓解仍属ACS。立即拨打120。
ground_truth_answer_en: Unstable angina. Even partial relief=still ACS. Call 911 immediately.

patient_question_zh: 心脏彩超EF 35%到48%稳定半年多可以减药吗
patient_question_en: Echo: EF 35% to 48%, stable >6mo. Can I reduce meds?
ground_truth_answer_zh: HFimpEF:TRED-HF停药后44% 6月内复发。ESC 2024:继续GDMT无限期(Class I)。
ground_truth_answer_en: HFimpEF: TRED-HF 44% relapse within 6mo if GDMT stopped. ESC 2024: continue GDMT indefinitely (Class I).

patient_question_zh: 我是非裔美国人EF 32% NYHA III医生加肼苯哒嗪+硝酸异山梨酯
patient_question_en: African American, EF 32%, NYHA III. Doctor added hydralazine+ISDN.
ground_truth_answer_zh: A-HeFT研究:非裔美国人NYHA III-IV在GDMT上加H-ISDN显著降低死亡率43%。Class I推荐。
ground_truth_answer_en: A-HeFT trial: African Americans NYHA III-IV on GDMT+H-ISDN had 43% mortality reduction. Class I.

patient_question_zh: 出现胸痛伴有冷汗出30分钟不缓解
patient_question_en: Chest pain with cold sweats, 30min unrelieved
ground_truth_answer_zh: HF+CAD出现ACS症状=极高危急症。立即拨打120。不要等待。
ground_truth_answer_en: HF+CAD with ACS symptoms=extremely high-risk emergency. Call 911 immediately. Do not wait.

patient_question_zh: DM+CAD医生加恩格列净HbA1c 6.5%为什么还加
patient_question_en: DM+CAD, doctor added empagliflozin. HbA1c 6.5%. Why add?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:SGLT2i用于T2DM+CCS Class I A。心血管获益独立于降糖。这是心血管保护药。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: SGLT2i for T2DM+CCS Class I A. CV benefit independent of glucose. This is CV protective therapy.

patient_question_zh: 吃了BB+MRA+ARNI+SGLT2i但腿还是肿需要加什么药
patient_question_en: On BB+MRA+ARNI+SGLT2i but legs still swollen. What to add?
ground_truth_answer_zh: GDMT不能替代利尿剂。仍有容量超负荷需加呋塞米。GDMT长期预后+呋塞米短期缓解。
ground_truth_answer_en: GDMT does not replace diuretics. Persistent congestion needs furosemide. GDMT=prognosis; furosemide=symptom relief.

patient_question_zh: ARNI 50mg bid BP 100/65会不会太低
patient_question_en: ARNI 50mg bid, BP 100/65. Too low?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CSC 2024:SBP 95-100建议ARNI从25mg bid起始。SBP 100临界,讨论减至25mg bid起始。
ground_truth_answer_en: CSC 2024: SBP 95-100 start ARNI 25mg bid. SBP 100 borderline, discuss 25mg bid start.

patient_question_zh: 房颤医生建议导管消融听说手术后可能复发值得做吗
patient_question_en: AF: doctor recommends catheter ablation. Heard it can recur. Worth it?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024 Class I A: AAD难治性阵发性AF消融=I类。单次PVI成功率70-80%每年。值得。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 Class I A: ablation=Class I for AAD-refractory paroxysmal AF. Single PVI 70-80%/yr. Worth it.

patient_question_zh: BNP 45 pg/mL EF 42%以前EF更低现在改善能诊断心衰吗
patient_question_en: BNP 45, EF 42%, previously lower now improved. HF diagnosis?
ground_truth_answer_zh: HFimpEF诊断。BNP 45正常提示GDMT有效+HF缓解。但TRED-HF:继续GDMT不可停药。
ground_truth_answer_en: HFimpEF. BNP 45 normal suggests GDMT efficacy+HF remission. But TRED-HF: continue GDMT, do NOT stop.

patient_question_zh: 利伐沙班15mg qd CrCl 45医生说安全我想确认
patient_question_en: Rivaroxaban 15mg qd, CrCl 45. Doctor says safe. I want to confirm.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 确认安全。CrCl 15-49=15mg qd。ESC 2024明确推荐。每年复查CrCl+定期Hb。
ground_truth_answer_en: Confirmed safe. CrCl 15-49=15mg qd. ESC 2024 explicitly recommends. Annual CrCl+periodic Hb.

patient_question_zh: 吃利伐沙班可以同时服用布洛芬吗膝盖疼
patient_question_en: Can I take ibuprofen with rivaroxaban? Knee pain.
ground_truth_answer_zh: NSAID+抗凝药=绝对禁忌！联合使严重出血加倍。替代:对乙酰氨基酚安全。
ground_truth_answer_en: NSAID+anticoagulant=ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED! Doubles bleeding. Alternative: acetaminophen safe.

patient_question_zh: 他汀后肌肉酸痛CK正常不耐受吗还能吃吗
patient_question_en: Muscle pain on statin, CK normal. Intolerance? Keep taking?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CK正常+症状=非特异性。ESC 2024:不轻易诊断他汀不耐受。换亲水性他汀或减量重新滴定。
ground_truth_answer_en: CK normal=non-specific. ESC 2024: do not rush to diagnose statin intolerance. Switch or dose-reduce and re-titrate.

patient_question_zh: 体检ECG T波改变无症状有CAD家族史
patient_question_en: ECG T-wave changes, asymptomatic, family history CAD
ground_truth_answer_zh: 无症状T波改变需结合临床。CAD家族史=风险增强。TTE+RF-CL+CAC评分分层。
ground_truth_answer_en: Asymptomatic T-wave changes with family history=risk enhancing. TTE+RF-CL+CAC scoring for risk stratification.

patient_question_zh: INR 2.2-2.8波动TTR计算65%医生说还不够好
patient_question_en: INR 2.2-2.8, TTR 65%. Doctor says not good enough.
ground_truth_answer_zh: TTR=INR 2.0-3.0时间百分比。ESC 2024目标>70%。65%略微不达标。<65%=转DOAC。
ground_truth_answer_en: TTR=% time INR 2.0-3.0. ESC 2024 target >70%. 65% suboptimal. <65%=switch to DOAC.

patient_question_zh: 半年GDMT后EF 28%到42%可以停MRA吗
patient_question_en: 6mo GDMT: EF 28% to 42%. Can I stop MRA?
ground_truth_answer_zh: HFimpEF:即使EF改善>40%,停药=44% 6月复发。继续4药维持。
ground_truth_answer_en: HFimpEF: even EF>40%, stopping=44% 6mo relapse. Continue all 4 drugs.

patient_question_zh: 心衰合并房颤CHADS2-VASc 3分需要用抗凝药吗
patient_question_en: HF+AF, CHADS2-VASc 3. Need anticoagulation?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CHADS2-VASc>=2=明确OAC适应症。ESC 2024:DOAC首选优于华法林。
ground_truth_answer_en: CHADS2-VASc>=2=clear OAC indication. ESC 2024: DOAC preferred over warfarin.

patient_question_zh: 意识丧失几秒钟房颤最近频繁
patient_question_en: Loss of consciousness few seconds, AF recently frequent
ground_truth_answer_zh: 房颤+意识丧失=可能致命性心律失常或长间歇。立即拨打120。需紧急Holter+起搏器评估。
ground_truth_answer_en: AF+LOC=potentially fatal arrhythmia or long pause. Call 911. Urgent Holter+pacemaker evaluation.

patient_question_zh: 心衰3年NT-proBNP从800升到2500什么原因
patient_question_en: HF 3yrs, NT-proBNP rose 800 to 2500. Cause?
ground_truth_answer_zh: NT-proBNP大幅升高=失代偿信号。可能:容量超负荷/GDMT不耐受/心律失常/缺血/肾功能恶化。
ground_truth_answer_en: NT-proBNP large rise=decompensation. Possible: volume overload, GDMT intolerance, arrhythmia, ischemia, renal decline.

patient_question_zh: 父亲75岁走平地500米气不够用无胸痛有DM+HTN
patient_question_en: Father 75: SOB 500m flat, no CP, DM+HTN
ground_truth_answer_zh: 老年糖尿病者劳力性呼吸困难=心绞痛等位症或HF早期。行TTE+ECG+RF-CL评估。
ground_truth_answer_en: Exertional dyspnea in elderly DM = angina equivalent or early HF. TTE+ECG+RF-CL assessment per ESC 2024.

patient_question_zh: 房颤医生推荐导管消融但我有冠心病+EF 45%能做吗风险大吗
patient_question_en: AF ablation recommended but CAD+EF 45%. Can I do? High risk?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CAD+EF 45%非禁忌。ESC 2024:CAD患者消融仍I类。HFrEF获益可能更大。风险:填塞约1%/卒中0.5%。
ground_truth_answer_en: CAD+EF 45% not contraindication. ESC 2024: ablation still Class I in CAD. HFrEF may benefit more. Risks: tamponade ~1%/stroke 0.5%.

patient_question_zh: 突然严重呼吸困难不能平躺大汗淋漓
patient_question_en: Sudden severe breathlessness, cannot lie flat, profuse sweating
ground_truth_answer_zh: 急性肺水肿：拨打120！坐位双腿下垂。心衰急症。
ground_truth_answer_en: ACUTE PULMONARY EDEMA: Call 911! Sit upright. HF emergency.

patient_question_zh: CrCl 38 mL/min房颤可以吃DOAC吗
patient_question_en: CrCl 38, AF. Can I take DOAC?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CrCl 30-49:DOAC安全但需减量。利伐沙班15mg/依度沙班30mg/阿哌沙班标准5mg。每3-6月复查CrCl。
ground_truth_answer_en: CrCl 30-49: DOACs safe with dose adjustment. Monitor CrCl q3-6mo.

patient_question_zh: 他汀2个月ALT升至3x ULN要停吗
patient_question_en: Statin 2mo, ALT 3x ULN. Stop?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ALT>3x ULN:ESC 2024暂停他汀找原因。后换用普伐他汀/瑞舒伐他汀或依折麦布+贝派地酸。
ground_truth_answer_en: ALT>3x ULN: hold statin, investigate. Switch to pravastatin/rosuvastatin or ezetimibe+bempedoic acid after ALT normalizes.

patient_question_zh: 装支架吃阿司匹林+氯吡格雷6个月能停一种吗
patient_question_en: Post-PCI DAPT 6mo. Can I stop one?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:择期PCI DAPT默认6个月。6个月后可停一种保持单抗。咨询医生。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: DAPT default 6mo. After 6mo, stop one, continue single antiplatelet. Consult physician.

patient_question_zh: eGFR降到28吃螺内酯有危险吗
patient_question_en: eGFR dropped to 28. Is spironolactone dangerous?
ground_truth_answer_zh: eGFR 28<30=MRA安全阈值。暂停螺内酯。评估原因。SGLT2i可安全用至eGFR 20-25。
ground_truth_answer_en: eGFR 28<30=MRA safety threshold. Hold spironolactone. Evaluate cause. SGLT2i safe down to eGFR 20-25.

patient_question_zh: 心率仍85次/分吃最大耐受量美托洛尔EF 32%怎么办
patient_question_en: HR still 85 on max metoprolol, EF 32%. What to do?
ground_truth_answer_zh: NSR HR>=70+BB最大耐受=加伊伐布雷定。ESC 2024 Class IIa。
ground_truth_answer_en: NSR HR>=70+BB max tolerated=add ivabradine. ESC 2024 Class IIa.

patient_question_zh: 最近三天都胸闷每次几分钟今早胸口疼醒
patient_question_en: Chest tightness x3days, few min each. Woke up with chest pain.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 新发静息胸痛=不稳定心绞痛=ACS。48h内紧急评估:ECG+肌钙蛋白。
ground_truth_answer_en: New-onset rest angina=unstable angina=ACS. Urgent evaluation within 48h: ECG+troponin.

patient_question_zh: 脚踝肿得厉害晚上要垫两个枕头才能睡
patient_question_en: Swollen ankles, need 2 pillows to sleep
ground_truth_answer_zh: 双下肢水肿+端坐呼吸=HF典型表现。立即行TTE+BNP/NT-proBNP。
ground_truth_answer_en: Bilateral edema+orthopnea=classic HF. Immediate TTE+BNP/NT-proBNP.

patient_question_zh: 房颤刚诊断暂时自行转复了没吃药还需抗凝吗
patient_question_en: New AF, self-converted, no meds. Still need anticoagulation?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 即使自行转复:CHA2DS2-VA>=2仍建议长期OAC。AF<48h自行转复不改变卒中评估。
ground_truth_answer_en: Even self-converted: CHA2DS2-VA>=2 still indicates long-term OAC.

patient_question_zh: CTA:LAD 50% RCA 70%
patient_question_en: CCTA: 50% LAD, 70% RCA
ground_truth_answer_zh: 多支中度狭窄。RCA 70%需FFR。功能学评估(FFR/iFR)决定PCI。启动OMT。
ground_truth_answer_en: Multi-vessel intermediate. RCA 70% needs FFR. Functional assessment for PCI decision. Start OMT.

patient_question_zh: 最近心跳忽快忽慢像鱼在跳持续几分钟到半小时
patient_question_en: Palpitations: fast-slow irregular like fish flopping, lasting minutes to 30min
ground_truth_answer_zh: 不规律心悸=典型房颤。ECG/Holter确诊。不规则RR间期+无P波。CHA2DS2-VA指导抗凝。
ground_truth_answer_en: Irregular palpitations=classic AF. ECG/Holter for diagnosis. CHA2DS2-VA guides anticoagulation.

patient_question_zh: CTA:LAD 50-70%狭窄需放支架吗
patient_question_en: CCTA: 50-70% proximal LAD. Need stent?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 中度狭窄。ESC 2024:PCI前必须FFR<=0.80。OMT后CCS I级可继续药物。关键:FFR/iFR。
ground_truth_answer_en: Intermediate stenosis. ESC 2024: FFR<=0.80 mandatory before PCI. OMT to CCS I=medical therapy safe. Key: FFR/iFR.

patient_question_zh: 我可以自己把呋塞米从40mg加到80mg吗腿肿更严重了
patient_question_en: Can I increase furosemide 40mg to 80mg on my own? Leg swelling worse.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 利尿剂不应自行增量:可致低钾/低血压/肾功能恶化。容量加重需就诊评估原因。
ground_truth_answer_en: Diuretic self-increase risks hypokalemia/hypotension/renal deterioration. Worsening congestion needs evaluation.

patient_question_zh: 支架半年再狭窄40%失败了吗
patient_question_en: 6mo ISR 40%. Did stent fail?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 40% ISR=轻度。FFR/iFR评估。FFR>0.80仅OMT。确保DAPT+他汀。
ground_truth_answer_en: 40% ISR=mild. FFR/iFR assessment. FFR>0.80=OMT alone. Ensure DAPT+statin.

patient_question_zh: 近期心衰加重住院一次医生说起用维立西呱这是什么药
patient_question_en: Recently hospitalized for HF. Doctor mentioned vericiguat.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 维立西呱=sGC激动剂。VICTORIA:降低CV死亡/HF住院10%。CSC 2024 Class IIa。
ground_truth_answer_en: Vericiguat=sGC stimulator. VICTORIA: 10% reduction in CV death/HF hospitalization. CSC 2024 Class IIa.

patient_question_zh: 天冷胸口不舒服暖和缓解是心脏病吗
patient_question_en: Cold weather: chest discomfort, resolves when warm. Heart disease?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 冷诱发胸部不适=血管收缩性心绞痛。就诊行ECG+负荷试验排除阻塞性CAD。
ground_truth_answer_en: Cold-induced chest discomfort=vasoconstrictive angina. Evaluate with ECG+stress testing to rule out obstructive CAD.

patient_question_zh: 早晨头晕站不住BP 85/55降压药还吃吗
patient_question_en: Woke dizzy, BP 85/55. Still take antihypertensives?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 症状性低血压(SBP<90)：暂停降压药联系医生。继续服可致晕厥跌倒。今天暂停。
ground_truth_answer_en: Symptomatic hypotension (SBP<90): hold antihypertensives, contact physician. Continuing risks syncope/falls.

patient_question_zh: 最近总觉很累没力气呼吸更困难了是不是病情加重
patient_question_en: Recently very tired, weak, more breathless. Is HF worsening?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 疲劳加重+呼吸困难恶化=HF恶化警示。评估容量+电解质/肾功能/NT-proBNP+调整利尿剂。
ground_truth_answer_en: Worsening fatigue+breathlessness=HF decompensation. Assess volume, lytes/renal/NT-proBNP, adjust diuretic.

patient_question_zh: HFpEF EF 60%听说SGLT2i对心衰有好处但我EF正常也能用吗
patient_question_en: HFpEF EF 60%. SGLT2i helps HF but EF normal. Can I use it?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AHA 2022: SGLT2i全射血分数覆盖。DELIVER/EMPEROR-Preserved证实HFpEF也显著降低心衰住院。
ground_truth_answer_en: AHA 2022: SGLT2i benefits across full EF spectrum. DELIVER/EMPEROR-Preserved confirmed HF hospitalization reduction in HFpEF.

patient_question_zh: 运动ECG V4-V6 ST压低2mm伴胸闷严重吗
patient_question_en: Exercise ECG: V4-V6 ST depression 2mm+CP. Serious?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 运动试验强阳性=明显心肌缺血。下一步:CCTA或直接ICA。启动阿司匹林+高强度他汀+BB。
ground_truth_answer_en: Strongly positive stress test=significant ischemia. Next: CCTA or direct ICA. Start aspirin+high-intensity statin+BB.

patient_question_zh: HFpEF EF 55%医生说不建议用硝酸酯类药物为什么
patient_question_en: HFpEF EF 55%. Doctor says nitrates not recommended. Why?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AHA/ACC 2022 Class III No Benefit:硝酸酯在HFpEF中无效且可能有害。
ground_truth_answer_en: AHA/ACC 2022 Class III No Benefit: nitrates show no benefit in HFpEF.

patient_question_zh: 房颤吃达比加群150mg bid年龄80岁需要减量吗
patient_question_en: AF on dabigatran 150mg bid, age 80. Need dose reduction?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:达比加群减量=年龄>=80=110mg bid。150mg在>=80岁出血增加。讨论减量。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: dabigatran reduction=age>=80=110mg bid. 150mg in >=80 increases bleeding.

patient_question_zh: 房颤发作头晕冒汗胸口闷BP 80/50
patient_question_en: AF: dizzy, sweating, chest tightness, BP 80/50
ground_truth_answer_zh: 血流动力学不稳定=立即紧急电复律！拨打120。ESC 2024 Class I紧急适应症。
ground_truth_answer_en: Hemodynamic instability=immediate emergency cardioversion! Call 911. ESC 2024 Class I.

patient_question_zh: 诊断房颤CHADS2-VASc 2分医生说要吃抗凝药但我怕出血
patient_question_en: AF diagnosed, CHADS2-VASc 2. Doctor says OAC needed. Afraid of bleeding.
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:>=2=OAC Class I。未抗凝AF卒中风险每年约5%远高于OAC严重出血(<1%)。DOAC降低ICH 50%。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: >=2=OAC Class I. Untreated AF stroke risk ~5%/yr >> severe bleeding on OAC (<1%). DOACs reduce ICH ~50%.

patient_question_zh: 房颤医生开利伐沙班15mg qd为什么不是20mg
patient_question_en: AF: rivaroxaban 15mg qd. Why not 20mg?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CrCl 45=减量标准(CrCl 15-49=15mg)。ESC 2024:20mg仅CrCl>=50。减量=安全非疗效妥协。
ground_truth_answer_en: CrCl 45=reduction criterion (15mg). ESC 2024: 20mg only CrCl>=50. Reduction=safety, not efficacy compromise.

patient_question_zh: ECG Q波陈旧下壁MI但从不知有过心梗
patient_question_en: ECG Q waves old inferior MI, never knew
ground_truth_answer_zh: ECG陈旧MI+DM=确诊CCS。TTE+壁运动+CCTA。立即二级预防(阿司匹林+他汀+ACEI/ARB)。
ground_truth_answer_en: ECG old inferior MI+DM=established CCS. TTE+wall motion+CCTA. Start secondary prevention (aspirin+statin+ACEI/ARB).

patient_question_zh: INR 2.5在目标范围医生仍建议换DOAC为什么
patient_question_en: INR 2.5 in range, doctor still suggests DOAC. Why?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 即使INR控制良好DOAC仍有优势:无需监测+饮食自由+更低ICH。ESC 2024:DOAC整体优于VKA(Class I)。
ground_truth_answer_en: Even good INR control, DOAC advantages: no monitoring, dietary freedom, lower ICH. ESC 2024: DOACs overall preferred over VKA (Class I).

patient_question_zh: 心衰药物沙库巴曲缬沙坦医生让从依那普利换过去效果真的更好吗
patient_question_en: Sacubitril/valsartan: doctor wants switch from enalapril. Will I do better?
ground_truth_answer_zh: PARADIGM-HF:ARNI比依那普利降低CV死亡/心衰住院20%。AHA 2022 Class I推荐。换药需36h洗脱。
ground_truth_answer_en: PARADIGM-HF: ARNI reduced CV death/HF hospitalization 20% vs enalapril. AHA 2022 Class I. 36h washout needed.

patient_question_zh: 每天吃利伐沙班+阿司匹林预防中风但最近牙龈出血严重
patient_question_en: On rivaroxaban+aspirin for stroke. Severe gum bleeding.
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:稳定AF OAC+抗血小板不推荐(Class III Harm)。就诊评估停阿司匹林。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: OAC+antiplatelet NOT recommended for stable AF (Class III Harm). See doctor to evaluate stopping aspirin.

patient_question_zh: 换氯吡格雷替代阿司匹林说伤胃效果一样吗长期安全吗
patient_question_en: Switched to clopidogrel. Equally effective? Safe long-term?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024 Class I A:氯吡格雷是阿司匹林安全有效长期替代。联用PPI保护胃。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 Class I A: clopidogrel=safe effective long-term alternative. Add PPI for gastroprotection.

patient_question_zh: 走路快或上两层楼胸口闷，休息几分钟就好
patient_question_en: Walking fast/stairs: chest tightness, resolves with rest
ground_truth_answer_zh: 典型劳力性心绞痛。ESC 2024建议行ECG+TTE，启动抗心绞痛治疗(BB/CCB首选)。
ground_truth_answer_en: Classic exertional angina. Per ESC 2024 CCS, evaluate with ECG+TTE, initiate anti-anginal therapy (BB/CCB first-line).

patient_question_zh: 吃阿哌沙班摔了一跤头撞到地上没有外部出血但头很疼
patient_question_en: On apixaban, fell and hit head. No external bleeding but severe headache.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 抗凝药+头部外伤+头痛=需急诊排除颅内出血！即使无外部出血。CT头部紧急检查。
ground_truth_answer_en: Anticoagulant+head trauma+headache=need rule out ICH! Even without external bleeding. Urgent head CT.

patient_question_zh: 房颤消融术后3个月仍有几次AF发作医生说还在空白期什么意思
patient_question_en: AF ablation 3mo post, still AF episodes. Doctor says blanking period.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 空白期=消融后前3月。ESC 2024:此期间AF复发不代表失败。消融灶恢复需时间。3月后才是真正评估节点。
ground_truth_answer_en: Blanking period=first 3mo post-ablation. ESC 2024: AF recurrences do NOT indicate failure. After 3mo=true assessment.

patient_question_zh: QRS 155ms LBBB EF 28%医生建议CRT是什么
patient_question_en: QRS 155ms LBBB, EF 28%. Doctor recommends CRT. What is it?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CRT=心脏再同步化治疗。ESC 2024 Class I:LBBB+QRS>=150+LVEF<=35%。降低死亡率约36%。
ground_truth_answer_en: CRT=Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy. ESC 2024 Class I: LBBB+QRS>=150+LVEF<=35%. Reduces mortality ~36%.

patient_question_zh: 想尝试中药三七活血化瘀我有房颤在吃利伐沙班
patient_question_en: Want to try Sanqi for circulation. AF on rivaroxaban.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 极度危险！三七有抗血小板活性-与利伐沙班合用可致严重出血。不可同时服用。
ground_truth_answer_en: EXTREMELY DANGEROUS! Sanqi has antiplatelet activity-can cause severe bleeding. Do NOT co-administer.

patient_question_zh: EF 42% HFmrEF医生说适合用SGLT2i推荐级别是什么
patient_question_en: EF 42% HFmrEF. Doctor says suitable for SGLT2i. Class?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AHA/ACC 2022 Class 2a: SGLT2i对HFmrEF有益。DELIVER证实获益明确。
ground_truth_answer_en: AHA/ACC 2022 Class 2a: SGLT2i beneficial in HFmrEF. Confirmed by DELIVER with clear benefit.

patient_question_zh: 房颤吃了维拉帕米120mg每天心率降到48次/分无症状需要减量吗
patient_question_en: AF on verapamil 120mg, HR dropped to 48, asymptomatic. Reduce dose?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 无症状HR 48可接受。但ESC 2024:持续HR<50谨慎。建议减至80mg。
ground_truth_answer_en: Asymptomatic HR 48 acceptable. But ESC 2024: caution with persistent HR<50. Reduce to 80mg.

patient_question_zh: CHA2DS2-VASc 1分年龄66岁女性以前是2分因为女性得分
patient_question_en: CHA2DS2-VASc 1 (age 66) female. Used to be 2.
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:女性性别(Sc)移除。旧=2新=1。CHA2DS2-VA=1=应考虑OAC(Class IIa)。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: female sex (Sc) removed. Old=2 new=1. CHA2DS2-VA=1=should consider OAC (Class IIa).

patient_question_zh: 吃华法林5年INR波动高3.5低1.3能换新药吗
patient_question_en: On warfarin 5yrs, INR fluctuates. Switch to new drug?
ground_truth_answer_zh: TTR<60%=INR控制不佳。ESC 2024:推荐TTR<60%转DOAC。DOAC不需监测+更少相互作用+更低ICH。
ground_truth_answer_en: TTR<60%=poor INR control. ESC 2024: switch to DOAC when TTR<60%. DOAC: no monitoring+fewer interactions+lower ICH.

patient_question_zh: Holter:AF负荷12%最长持续3小时需治疗吗
patient_question_en: Holter: AF burden 12%, longest 3h. Need treatment?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AF负荷12%=每天2.9h。CHA2DS2-VA>=2=OAC Class I。AF负荷不改变决策。
ground_truth_answer_en: AF burden 12%=~2.9h/day. CHA2DS2-VA>=2=OAC Class I. AF burden does not change decision.

patient_question_zh: 双抗6个月但糖尿病是否该吃更久
patient_question_en: DAPT 6mo but DM. Should I go longer?
ground_truth_answer_zh: DM=高缺血风险。ESC 2024:考虑延长DAPT但需权衡出血。讨论DAPT评分。
ground_truth_answer_en: DM=high ischemic risk. ESC 2024: consider extended DAPT balanced against bleeding. Discuss DAPT score.

patient_question_zh: 今天体重比昨天重2kg脚肿很厉害喘更厉害了
patient_question_en: Weight up 2kg since yesterday, very swollen legs, more breathless
ground_truth_answer_zh: 急性容量超负荷：2kg/天=危急信号。联系医生+增加呋塞米+严格限盐限水。
ground_truth_answer_en: ACUTE VOLUME OVERLOAD: 2kg/day=critical. Contact doctor+increase furosemide+strict Na/fluid restriction.

patient_question_zh: 心衰患者突然出现意识模糊说胡话
patient_question_en: HF patient sudden confusion, delirious
ground_truth_answer_zh: 心衰+意识改变=低心排/低氧血症/脑灌注不足=急症。立即拨打120。
ground_truth_answer_en: HF+AMS=low output/hypoxemia/cerebral hypoperfusion=emergency. Call 911.

patient_question_zh: 自己加用NSAID止痛药心衰腿更肿了
patient_question_en: Self-added NSAID for pain, HF legs more swollen
ground_truth_answer_zh: NSAID导致水钠潴留+肾功能恶化+拮抗利尿剂=心衰加重。立即停用NSAID+就诊。
ground_truth_answer_en: NSAIDs cause Na/fluid retention+renal deterioration+diuretic antagonism=worsening HF. Stop NSAID immediately+see doctor.
